shortDescription: Short math, spelling and reading activities for ages 5–11. The app and learning activities are in English. Installed activities work offline.
longDescription:
Explore six short activities with Pip: math, spelling, reading, multiplication, logic and vocabulary. Hints, retries and explanations let children ages 5–11 practice at their own pace. Installed activities work offline.

The interface, stories and spelling activities are currently in English. A PIN protects parent settings, and progress stays on this device. There are no advertisements or public chat. Spoken guidance requires an installed English voice.

Development review version: the English activity pack awaits teacher review and is not a complete curriculum. This candidate offers free starter activities only; purchases, extra profiles and parent assignments are disabled.

Support: banksmi@mail.com
featureBullets: Six activity modes with English learning content
Short offline practice with hints and explanations
